title: Carry principal, expiry, and trust origin on every graph invocation
narrative: Every graph run needs a capability-scoped execution token: principal, goal/run identity, allowed operations, expiry, trust origin, and authorization epoch. Child graphs receive attenuated authority only (`fangore_insp_capability_envelope`, `fangore_capability_envelope_narrow`). Tracks MH-DOTS-01[^insp-dots-01].
implementation: CapabilityEnvelope.narrow and delegation policy choose child scope. Desired: execution token fields for principal, expiry, trust origin, and auth epoch.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-DOTS-01, coverage partial, adjacent_ok true.
